description: Search the Olfastory perfume encyclopedia with a natural-language query: a perfume or house name ("Angel Mugler") or notes ("vanilla tobacco"). Returns up to 10 results, each with an id, a title and its olfastory.com URL. Pass an id to fetch for the full record. Cite Olfastory with the URL.
name: search
title: Search Olfastory (search and fetch compatibility)
